purpose: Go somewhere for the purpose of an activity.
keywords: I am going to buy bread.
I went to see a friend.
restrictions: The first verb names the purpose; 行く expresses movement.
mistake: Use 食べに行く, not 食べるに行く.

segments.role: Go somewhere for the purpose of an activity. ます-stem + に + 行く.

examples.translation: I am going to buy bread.
